justification: A shows an architectural rock-cut facade with vertical panels and rectangular recesses cut into a cliff, with no figural imagery at all, while B shows curvilinear relief carvings on boulders suggesting stylised zoomorphic or serpentine forms with looping bodies and eye-like elements. The only correspondence is that both are cut into rock with linear grooves, which is a property of technique rather than depicted content, and no motif, figure or arrangement is shared.
